note: The gap this session's user report surfaced: Pizzas::Order's own PaymentGateway port (pizzas.hecksagon) had no Rust-generated dispatch entry at all — the deployed Lambda could never receive the event a real payment webhook fires, so the OnPizzaPaymentReceived policy (pizzas.bluebook) could never trigger Purchase. Exercises the happy path (Receive -> policy -> Purchase, mutating status to "sold" with no direct Purchase dispatch anywhere in this script) and the one new refusal surface a port operation adds beyond a command's own (a reference_to naming a record that was never created, routed through the SAME generated check_reference every command's own reference already uses).
